aggregation.evaluation: ten-repeat, event-disjoint two-fold cross-fit in both directions; Directional CF weights use training outcomes only; displayed points are pair-level aggregates across directions rather than directional regressions

best_single.formula: lower test-fold adjusted Brier of market and model on identical support
best_single.label: Best Single

cf_directional.formula: direction-specific clipped C / D weight fitted on the training fold
cf_directional.label: Directional CF

piecewise_odds.formula: threshold-5 piecewise transform of the summed market/model logits
piecewise_odds.label: Piecewise Odds

near_bi.definition: mean train-fold BI gap at most 2.0 points

aggregation.support_weighting: support-weighted across prompt/market pairs using repeated opposite-fold test target cells

metric.causal_warning: Correlation measures similarity, not incremental forecasting value.
metric.higher_means: closer linear alignment with the same freeze-time market probability
metric.label: Prediction Pearson correlation

provenance.configuration_selection: all eligible exact zero-shot and scratchpad with-freeze configurations
provenance.imputation_policy: exclude Polymarket rows backed only by original ForecastBench forecasts marked imputed=true
provenance.site_filter: require explicit 'with freeze values' and exclude configurations containing 'news'

scope: Every eligible zero-shot and scratchpad with-freeze configuration is kept as a separate observation; news-augmented configurations are excluded. Correlations use identical non-imputed Polymarket event support.
title: Freeze-only prompt ↔ Polymarket correlation
